candidates.title: Telangana to fast-track pending Urban Land Ceiling applications
candidates.excerpt: Telangana Revenue Minister Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy announced that the state government has initiated fast-track measures to resolve decades-old pending Urban Land Ceiling (ULC) applications, ensuring regularisation of eligible cases and relief for citizens facing land-related hardships.
